name: mujoco
description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
one_liner: A physics simulator that lets you test how robots, mechanical parts, or animated characters move and react to forces, without building anything physical first.
buyer: A robotics startup or university robotics lab that needs to test and train robot control software cheaply before touching real hardware.
business_use_cases: A robotics startup trains and tests a warehouse robot's walking or grasping behavior in simulation before spending money on physical prototypes.
A university lab uses it to teach control-theory courses and produce research papers, citing it as the standard open benchmark.
A game or VFX studio uses its physics engine to create more realistic character movement for a game or animated project.

money_ideas.idea: Robotics simulation consulting: build and tune a client's robot model before they spend on hardware
Paid training course on reinforcement learning in simulation using it

steal_this: Offer a fixed-fee 'simulate your robot design before you build it' service to a hardware startup this weekend.
